offering_description.value: Smart Sand sells northern white sand in coarse to fine grades to industrial customers. It extracts sand at four mines it owns and operates and tests it in-house.

quotes.quote: At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures we meet all your sand needs.

SmartSand is dedicated to the industrial market, ensuring a consistent, long-term supply of high-quality sand at competitive prices. Our industrial team, boasting over 100 years of combined experience, is committed to providing exceptional products to markets worldwide. Utilizing in-house state of the art technology for gradation, ADV, pH, LOI, Moisture, and XRF (Powder/Pellet).
